baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated ashab at words 1/4 and al-shimal at words 2/5, framed by ma.
baseline_models.mechanism: S-H-B supplies durable accompaniment and Sh-M-L supplies the left-hand direction. Repetition turns a side assignment into a settled corporate identity, while ma opens the quality of that identity for evaluation.

activation_trace.role: Companionship and sustained association make the referents a company bound to one designation.
The left hand or leftward direction supplies the spatial pole to which the company is attached.

changed_reading.before: A group located on the left.
changed_reading.after: A company constituted by lasting attachment to the leftward side, with its condition intensified by the repeated ma-frame.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Ashab and al-shimal recur as a tightly repeated possessive unit.
baseline_models.mechanism: S-H-B can make one thing an abiding companion of another, while Sh-M-L can describe all-sided enclosure and wrapping. The title can therefore profile people whose left-marked condition accompanies and surrounds them, not merely people standing at coordinates.

activation_trace.role: Making something accompany another turns the designation into a condition carried with its people.
Enclosure from all sides makes shimal a surrounding condition rather than only a direction.
Wrapping in a garment gives the enclosure a close, body-adjacent form.

changed_reading.after: A cohort inseparably accompanied and wrapped by a left-marked condition.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled title joins collective companionship to the polysemous al-shimal.
baseline_models.mechanism: Sh-M-L can move from side to human traits and from direction to an omen or low rank. Joined to durable companionship, the phrase can name a social-moral company whose shared habits issue in an adverse allotment.

activation_trace.role: Sustained association lets a repeated disposition define a company rather than an isolated individual.
Human traits and habitual character internalize the directional label as a shared profile.
The image of ill omen or low rank supplies the adverse outcome of that shared profile.

changed_reading.after: A company recognized by habituated traits and the disastrous rank or fortune those traits have become.

context_deltas.mechanism: The enveloping baseline becomes a failed refuge: a cover exists, yet penetrating heat and blackness occupy it, and it grants neither thermal relief nor honorable reception. S-H-B makes this anti-shelter continuously accompany its occupants.

activation_trace.role: Abiding companionship makes the hostile environment continuous rather than momentary.
All-sided enclosure supplies the spatial form that the following environment fills.
A penetrating hot wind makes the enclosure porous to injury rather than protective.
Blackness, coal, and smoke give the offered shade its obscuring hostile substance.
Shade literally supplies cover, allowing the passage to construct and then negate refuge.
Coolness as heat's opposite is explicitly denied, defining the cover by failed relief.
Honor and generosity are also denied, extending failed shelter into failed reception.

structural_cues: 56:42 places the company inside the paired environment with fi; 56:43 offers shade; 56:44 answers with coordinated negations.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies penetration, dark cover, and two denied benefits; I make these properties retroact on Sh-M-L's enclosure and S-H-B's accompaniment to form an anti-shelter. A live alternative is a simple list of punishments that does not reshape the title.

changed_reading.after: Their left-marked enclosure is a total anti-shelter whose cover admits harm and withholds both relief and honorable reception.

context_deltas.mechanism: Prior luxury releases its possessor, but repeated persistence knots conduct around guilt. The context thus gives the disposition baseline a causal biography: unrestrained ease becomes self-binding habit, and habit stabilizes membership in the company.

activation_trace.role: Durable association turns repeated conduct into corporate identity.
Human traits supply the inward locus in which prior conduct becomes a defining disposition.
Expansive luxury that lets its possessor loose supplies the permissive starting condition.
Tying and knotting render persistence as the self-binding mechanism that fixes identity.
Persistence and resolve supply the repeated agency by which the knot is maintained.
Guilt or grave fault supplies the conduct around which persistence hardens.

structural_cues: 56:45's causal inna-clause locates the condition before the outcome; 56:46 repeats kanu with the habitual imperfect yusirrun.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies released luxury, persistence, knotting, and guilt; I infer a causal arrow from permissive ease through repeated conduct to fixed company identity. The alternative is that luxury and persistence are independent charges rather than stages.

changed_reading.before: A company marked by adverse disposition and fortune.
changed_reading.after: A company that has fastened itself into its adverse identity: prior unrestrained ease becomes the setting in which repetition knots conduct into character.

context_deltas.mechanism: Death and dust disperse and still bodies; resurrection stirs them; first and last span the temporal field; gathering at a fixed limit recomposes them. Sh-M-L's reunion after dispersal and S-H-B's company convert the title from a local side-group into a transhistorical assembled body.

activation_trace.role: Companionship supplies the corporate form into which separated persons are recomposed.
Reunion after dispersal supplies the focus-root image activated by resurrection and gathering.
Stillness and decay supply the dispersed, inactive state from which the company must be recovered.
Stirring what is still supplies the reversal from inactive remains to an assembling population.
Beginning and precedence mark the early endpoint of the population's temporal span.
Lastness after the first marks the late endpoint, completing the temporal span.
Joining what was scattered supplies the direct operation that creates one company.
A fixed time or limit synchronizes the otherwise dispersed population.

structural_cues: The skeptical question of 56:47-48 is answered by qul and the emphatic passive plural la-majmu'un in 56:49-50.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies stillness, reactivation, temporal endpoints, gathering, and appointment; I infer that this sequence retroactively defines ashab as the company produced by that assembly. The alternative is that assembly only relocates an already fixed class.

changed_reading.before: A contemporaneous cohort assigned to one side.
changed_reading.after: A company constituted at an appointed assembly from dispersed dead across the whole first-to-last temporal range.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence moves hostile matter from environment to ingestion, swallowing, vessel-filling, inward permeation, and renewed thirst. Punishment therefore becomes an inseparable companion from inside, while Sh-M-L's enclosure contracts from surrounding habitat to occupied interior.

activation_trace.role: Making one thing accompany another supplies the bond formed when hostile matter is taken into the body.
Enclosure from all sides shifts scale from external atmosphere to a filled bodily interior.
Taking food supplies the first transfer of hostile matter across the body's boundary.
Swallowing and gulping sharpen consumption into forced inward passage.
Filling to the measure of a vessel makes occupation of the interior total.
The belly as an inside names the bodily enclosure in which hostile matter now resides.
Drinking's image of permeating color and heart lets intake become assimilation rather than contact alone.
Thirst that cannot be quenched closes a feedback loop that compels renewed intake.

structural_cues: The consecutive participles move from eating in 56:52 to filling in 56:53 and repeated drinking in 56:54-55.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies intake, swallowing, full interior volume, permeation, and unquenched thirst; I infer a directional arrow from external punishment to embodied companionship and a self-renewing loop. The alternative is a purely somatic sequence with no retroaction on ashab or shimal.

changed_reading.before: The company is surrounded by a hostile condition.
changed_reading.after: The company repeatedly takes that condition inside until it fills and permeates them, making punishment their embodied companion without satisfying the drive that renews it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The deictic close recasts the preceding food and drink as prepared guest provision, while D-Y-N identifies its occasion as reckoning and recompense. The social noun ashab is thereby drawn into an inverted hospitality scene: the company's adverse rank determines its reception.

activation_trace.role: Companionship supplies the social register that the closing guest-provision language reverses.
Ill omen or low rank determines the degraded quality of the company's reception.
The day's severe event gives the hospitality scene its bounded occasion.
Provision prepared for a visitor explicitly recodes the prior intake as an offered reception.
Reckoning and recompense explain why this particular provision belongs to this company.

structural_cues: The demonstrative hadha and possessive nuzuluhum point backward over the food-and-drink chain before the terminal yawm al-din.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies retrospective deixis, their prepared provision, and recompense; I infer that the title anticipates an inverted host-guest relation. The live alternative is that nuzul is only a closing ironic label and does not modify the social force of ashab.

changed_reading.before: A company with an ominous rank.
changed_reading.after: A company received with a prepared anti-feast whose form is the recompense appropriate to the identity they formed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because hamim in the sequence denotes the hot medium, not a human relative; it remains anchored through the focus's companionship noun and H-M-M's genuine close-kin branch. Render it only as an ironic lexical echo of hostile intimacy, not as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Ashab at 56:41 names companionship; hamim immediately follows at 56:42.

activation_trace.role: Companionship supplies the social relation that the following polysemy darkly echoes.
Close kinship or intimacy makes the hot medium an ironic nearest associate rather than scenery alone.

changed_reading.before: The company is accompanied by a hot punishment.
changed_reading.after: At the level of lexical echo, its nearest intimate is the boiling medium itself: social proximity has become hostile proximity.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because al-shimal is ordinarily read directionally here and the north-wind branch is secondary; it remains anchored in the repeated focus root and is answered by penetrating hot wind plus explicit denial of coolness. Render it as a contrastive activation, not as the phrase's primary lexical sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The repeated al-shimal at words 2/5 can carry the north wind and its cooling effect.

activation_trace.role: The north wind and what it cools create a suppressed thermal expectation inside the title.
A penetrating hot wind replaces the cooling wind expected by the focus-root branch.
The explicit denial of coolness completes the thermal reversal.

changed_reading.before: Shimal marks only the leftward side.
changed_reading.after: The title briefly raises a north-wind cooling expectation that the context reverses into penetrating heat and not-cool shade.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because scattered remnants are a remote Sh-M-L branch and the strong model uses reunion instead; it remains anchored in the focus root and meets a direct contextual reversal in complete gathering. Render it as a subordinate remnant-to-totality pattern, not a standalone gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Al-shimal at words 2/5 has a branch of sparse, scattered remnants.

activation_trace.role: Sparse scattered remnants supply the fragmentary starting image latent in the title.
Joining dispersed pieces reverses the remnant image into an assembled company.
Completion without dispersion or deficit totalizes what the focus branch pictured as sparse remains.

changed_reading.before: The title names a coherent side-group.
changed_reading.after: A subordinate branch pictures scattered remnants that the appointed gathering reverses into a complete, deficiency-free company.

strongest_changes: The surrounding left-marked condition becomes a porous anti-shelter that admits harm while denying relief and honor.
Prior ease and repeated fault give the company a causal biography in which conduct knots itself into identity.
Resurrection and fixed-time gathering make the company transhistorical: dispersed dead from first to last are recomposed as one body.
Eating, filling, and unquenched drinking move punishment from environment into an embodied, self-renewing companionship.
The final nuzul recasts the sequence as recompensive anti-hospitality.
summary.what_was_special: The repeated two-root title proved unusually receptive to scale changes: side became enclosure, enclosure became bodily interior, companionship became both self-formed identity and appointed assembly, and the social label culminated in inverted reception.
remaining_uncertainties: The enclosure and character branches of Sh-M-L may be latent overlays rather than active senses in the focus construction.
The internalization sequence may describe punishment without intentionally retroacting on the title.
The north-wind reversal, intimate-heat echo, and scattered-remnant pattern require explicit downstream qualification.
